name: Falling Text Gravity
description: Full-screen text statements with inline images that break into characters and fall off the screen under simulated gravity as each line scrolls past the top of the viewport.
contents: List of full-height text sections, each a headline mixing words and inline tilted images
behavior: Each line is split into characters with SplitText
When a line reaches the top of the viewport its characters fall with Physics2D gravity, random rotation, then fade out
editableByProps: Text lines, inline images and their tilt classes
Background and text colors, section height and text width
Fall speed, gravity, duration and rotation range

needsCodeEdit.change: Trigger the fall at a different scroll position
needsCodeEdit.where: start value in the scrollTrigger object inside onSplit
text-[2.5rem] sm:text-[3rem] md:text-[4rem] classes on the h1

fixed: Text falls only on scroll past the top of the viewport and plays once per line
Sections are viewport-tall and the wrapper has a 350vh minimum height so there is scroll room for the effect
